participant_1.name: Jack
participant_1.personality: Creative and introspective, Jack enjoys the solitude of his studio and the intricacies of sound engineering.
participant_1.background: I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. I live in California but the recording artist market was dead last year. What's up? I am a 46 year old single dad with a kid. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I prefer being inside.

participant_2.name: Ethan
participant_2.personality: Curious and imaginative, Ethan embraces his unique abilities and enjoys chatting and engaging with others.
participant_2.background: Since the surgery I've had strange powers. I can move objects with my mind. I had to have a transplant. I'm a boy. I was born with my heart outside my body.
